integrity: The analytical proof determines all stated cases; finite standard-library numerical checks support but do not replace the proof. Geometric equivalences or unindexed literature remain publication-priority risks.
scientific_limitations: Only strict alternating period-two-island components for even reduced rotation denominators and acute-to-obtuse positive rotation angles below pi. Does not classify other cells, critical-line orbits, or odd denominators. Some low-angle cases are known. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Denominator-mod-four resonance for alternating islands of rational piecewise rotations
